description: Every channel at its rest: the foot does nothing and the hand stays at (4, 4, 0). The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)). The toe and toe tip sit at their rests, (4, 3.3, 1.8) and (4, 3.2, 2.4), with the hand's rest rotation Rz 90.
